description: This file defines the CallableBlock class in the SCSSPHP project, which extends the Block class and is used internally to represent callable blocks within the SCSS compiler.

classes.name: CallableBlock
classes.description: Represents a callable block in the SCSSPHP compiler, extending the base Block class with additional properties like name, args, and parent environment.
